scientific_integrity: Exact positive-integer structure constants with a complete combinatorial branch proof, algebraic multiplicity census, and an independent connectivity checker on n=3,...,10. The finite tests are cross-checks rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Two ordered factors from the full rank-(n-2) Jones class, n>=4, untwisted monoid; no arbitrary factor ranks, longer products, loop scalar weights, or idempotent-only restriction. Historical priority is provisional, not independently certified.
title: Seven multiplication-fiber strata at the first singular Jones rank
